drawings.description: feuillet de dessins, sans texte. Trois rangées de disques coupés par des cordes (droites ou arcs), parfois concourantes en un point marqué, une région parfois hachurée ; sous chaque disque ou groupe de disques réuni par une accolade, un petit graphe : un point, deux points, un segment, trois points, un segment et un point, un chemin à trois sommets, un triangle — apparemment le graphe dont les sommets sont les cordes et les arêtes leurs croisements. Plusieurs dessins sont marqués « ok » de sa main (le disque à trois cordes concourantes au-dessus d'un segment, le disque au triangle hachuré au-dessus du triangle, avec en variante « ou » un disque à cordes concourantes) ; sous une rangée de disques à quatre cordes parallèles, un « ? ». En bas à droite, des lignes brisées épaisses
drawings.kind: page of disks cut by chords, with their crossing graphs
drawings.notes: Redrawn disk by disk from a fresh crop of p. 9 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Each disk is an ellipse fitted to his outline; every straight chord is clipped to that ellipse, so that it ends exactly on it, and where a disk carries a marked point the chords are drawn through that one point; the short curved chords (caps) are drawn as curves whose ends lie on the outline; heavy segments are drawn between the computed crossings of their chords (the X of the 7th disk of row 1, the two disks with a heavy middle bar and the ok disk of row 3), and the hatched triangle of row 1 between the crossings of its three chords. Row 1: one chord, two chords, X through a point (ok), three parallel chords and the disk with three caps (joined by a brace, three points ringed), the disk with a point and a cap (segment and point ringed), the X with a heavy bar and a third chord (ok, path of three vertices), the hatched triangle (ok, triangle), and "(ou" a disk with three chords through a point. Row 2: four parallel chords (outer two curved), three chords and a small cap, four caps (brace, four points, "?"); four disks with two chords through a point and caps, the last with a stroke rising from it (brace; segment and two points). Row 3: two pairs of chords through two points (ok; two segments); a disk with three chords, a curved fourth and a hatched region, and two disks with two chords and a heavy cross bar (brace; path of three vertices and a point); the ok disk with four chords and its heavy path (path of four vertices); the thick broken line at the bottom right and the strokes near it (a heavy stroke from the last graph, faint pencil strokes). Left out: small ticks where he starts an outline or a chord, an ink blot in the last disk of row 2 and a smudge under the ou-variant. Still differs: the outlines are ellipses (some of his are rounder at a corner); the hatched region of the first disk of row 3 is a reading of loose zigzag strokes (it could also be a scribbling-out). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-09 after Michel's check (#136): yes, as redrawn; the region of the second disk of row 3 is hatched (a hatched polygon bounded by the three chords and the curved fourth side), not scribbled out; ok.

drawings.description: feuillet de dessins de la même famille que la page 9 : disques coupés de cordes, une région triangulaire ou quadrangulaire hachurée, trois marqués « OK », des variantes introduites par « ou » ; sous eux les graphes : un triangle, un point, un tripode épais en « Y », un carré, un triangle surmonté d'un segment, un rectangle coupé d'une diagonale, un triangle à point intérieur. À droite, deux axes fléchés en équerre et, dans l'angle, des courbes qui se croisent et deux disques coupés d'arcs
drawings.kind: page of disks cut by chords, with their graphs, and crossing curves
drawings.notes: Redrawn from a fresh crop of p. 11 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Each disk is an ellipse fitted to his outline; every chord is clipped to it, so that it ends exactly on it; chords through a marked point are drawn through that one point; hatched regions and heavy segments are bounded by the computed crossings of their chords; two chords that he bends where they cross another (first disk, and the disk in the middle of row 2) are drawn as two straight pieces meeting on that chord. Top row: the disk with three chords and a hatched triangle (and a cap at the bottom), "ou" a small disk with three chords through a point; the OK disk with three verticals and a horizontal chord heavy between the outer verticals (dots at the ends of the horizontal, small circles at the ends of the middle vertical); the OK disk with four chords and a hatched quadrilateral; the ok disk with three chords, a hatched triangle, a heavy chord and a heavy part, "ou" a small disk with chords through a point. Graphs: triangle, point, the thick tripod Y, square, triangle with a segment on top. Row 2: the disk with a hatched bow tie; the OK disk, hatched and overdrawn with heavy zigzags, drawn as four chords with the region between the two long diagonals hatched up to the right-hand vertical; "ou ( ... )" with two small disks (crossing chords with a dark centre; four chords through a point); the disk with three chords, one bent, and a hatched triangle. Bottom: the rectangle with a diagonal, the triangle with an inner point. Right: the two arrowed axes at right angles (the vertical one drawn in several strokes, one arrow drawn on each), the upper disk cut by three chords and two arcs, the lower closed curve with the arcs crossing it, the long curves and lines crossing the region, two arrowheads as on the page. Left out: the struck b-like sign by the tripod and the zigzag between the rectangle and the triangle, small crosses and ticks at chord ends, a small squiggle between the two small disks. Still differs: the inner structure of the scribbled OK disk of row 2 is a reading (the zigzags may be a scribbling-out rather than hatching); the dark centres of the two small disks are drawn as a hatched quadrilateral and a point; the crossing curves at the right are read stroke by stroke, not as a figure. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin : un disque coupé de deux cordes horizontales $E_1$ (en haut) et $E_2$ (en bas) ; au-dessus de $E_1$, la calotte $\Sigma_1^+$, et une accolade à droite réunit tout ce qui est sous $E_1$ : $\Sigma_1^-$ ; sous $E_2$, la calotte $\Sigma_2^+$, et une accolade à gauche réunit tout ce qui est au-dessus de $E_2$ : $\Sigma_2^-$
drawings.kind: disk cut by two chords, with caps and braces
drawings.notes: Disk cut by two horizontal chords E_1 (top) and E_2 (bottom); the cap Sigma_1^+ above E_1, a brace on the right gathering all below E_1 (Sigma_1^-); the cap Sigma_2^+ under E_2, a brace on the left gathering all above E_2 (Sigma_2^-). A struck label above E_1 and the struck words around are left out.

drawings.description: à gauche, un petit croquis : trois points $x$ (en bas), $y$ et $z$ (en haut), avec des flèches $x\to y$, $x\to z$ et deux traits croisés
drawings.notes: As on the page: z at the upper left, y at the upper right, x at the bottom, three small points (above the middle, by y, above x). Towards z, two arrows (a thin one from the lower middle, a heavy one with a doubled head from the middle); towards y, two arrows (a thin one from the lower middle, a heavy shorter one); two heavy strokes, at the lower left and at the lower right, across the pair of directions (the crossed strokes), and a short dash in the middle. Doubled strokes are drawn once each. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: page sans texte : croquis au crayon d'une même opération de collage en volume — un disque vu en perspective relié par un tube court à une feuille rectangulaire ; un petit cercle traversé d'un trait entre deux arcs ; un grand rectangle à qui une bande est attachée par le haut ; une feuille en perspective portant deux petits cylindres dressés. En haut à droite, à l'encre, le trait vertical à extrémités recourbées du premier croquis de la page 53
drawings.kind: page of pencil sketches of a gluing in volume
drawings.notes: Faint pencil, redrawn at its places: a disk seen in perspective (two offset ellipses, the near rim heavy where he inked it) joined by a short tube (two lines, small rings at its ends) to a sheet standing behind it (its top edge and right edge) with a rectangular piece below the tube (heavy stroke at its upper left); a small circle crossed by a stroke between two arcs; a large rectangle with a band (two verticals and a U) attached at its top, its sides joined at the bottom to the sheet below; a sheet in perspective carrying two small upright cylinders, with the strokes of its edges as drawn; at the top right, in ink, the two small curled marks (from p. 53) and the faint stroke between them. Faint doublings reduced to one stroke. Still differs: the edges of the lower sheet are a reading of overlapping faint strokes. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
